check.sentence: Finally, according to univariable binary logistic regression analysis, patients with a HALP score ≤ 17.975 had a 1-year mortality risk 11.794 times that of patients with a HALP score ≥ 17.975 (OR: 11.794, 95% CI [7.194–19.338], p < 0.001); the risk of patients with CRP > 28.145 was 3.714 times that of patients with CRP ≤ 28.145 (OR: 3.714, 95% CI [2.417–5.705], p < 0.001) and the risk of patients with CAR > 0.6574 was 4.139 times that of patients with CAR ≤ 0.6574 (OR: 4.139, 95% CI [2.685–6.380], p < 0.001) (Table 4).
